description: Fetch a single OEIS integer sequence by its A-number (e.g. "A000045" for the Fibonacci numbers, "A000040" for the primes). Accepts the A-number with or without the "A" prefix and zero-padding ("A000045", "45", and "000045" are all valid). Returns the full record: name, terms (data), comments, formulas, keywords, offset, author, and reference count. Use this to get the formula or mathematical description of a known sequence.

id.description: An OEIS A-number such as "A000045", or just "45" / "000045".

name: get_sequence
title: Get Sequence
